summary: Manual WeChat DevTools preview / real-device QA ledger for sunflower-miniapp MVP user path. Keep AppID, tokens, phone numbers, payment payloads, screenshots with personal data, and merchant credentials out of Git.

environment.notes: Use ignored local sunflower-miniapp/project.private.config.json for real AppID preview/real-device validation, and use an HTTPS legal request domain.

checks.requirement: Preview/release API requests use an HTTPS domain that is configured as a legal WeChat request domain and has a valid certificate.
checks.evidence: Not recorded in repo. Default API base remains bare HTTP IP for DevTools/local validation only.
checks.nextAction: Set SUNFLOWER_API_BASE_URL to the HTTPS API domain in a local preview build and record domain/date/certificate result without secrets.

checks.requirement: Real preview/real-device run uses a local uncommitted real AppID while the committed project.config.json remains touristappid.
checks.nextAction: Copy project.private.config.example.json to ignored project.private.config.json, set the real AppID locally, run preview, and verify git diff does not include the real AppID.

checks.requirement: wx.login obtains a code, backend /api/auth/wechat/login returns token/profile, token is stored, and /api/users/me can restore profile state.
checks.nextAction: Run login in develop/trial preview or real device and record sanitized result, envVersion, and token/profile success summary.

checks.requirement: getPhoneNumber returns a phone authorization code, /api/auth/bind-phone succeeds, and the order form receives the bound phone.
checks.nextAction: Run phone binding on preview/real device and record masked phone suffix or non-secret success summary only.

checks.requirement: Home loads banners, services, featured rooms, member benefits, and uses the configured API base.
checks.evidence: Automated smoke covers files/syntax only; preview or real-device content load is not recorded.
checks.nextAction: Open home in preview/real device and record sanitized content-load result.

checks.requirement: User can browse rooms, filter by keyword/date, open room detail, view calendar/pricing/rules, and navigate to order creation.
checks.nextAction: Run booking/room-detail flow and record room alias/date range and sanitized result.

checks.requirement: Order create blocks invalid/unbound-phone submission, accepts valid guest data after phone binding, creates an order, and navigates to pay or order list.
checks.nextAction: Run with QA room/date and record sanitized order alias/id suffix only.

checks.requirement: When backend explicitly returns MOCK_WECHAT_PAY, payment flow confirms through /api/orders/{orderId}/pay/confirm and order list refreshes.
checks.evidence: Code path exists in utils/mvp/payment.js, but preview/manual result is not recorded.
checks.nextAction: Run in approved dev/test environment if mock mode is enabled and record sanitized result.

checks.requirement: In production payment mode, wx.requestPayment is invoked, one low-value payment succeeds, backend confirm/status update is visible, and cancel/failure feedback is understandable.
checks.nextAction: Requires explicit user approval before real payment. Record non-secret transaction evidence only.

checks.requirement: Order list loads, filters supported statuses, can cancel an unpaid order, submit reschedule request for eligible order, and submit refund request for eligible order.
checks.nextAction: Use QA orders and record sanitized action outcomes; waive unsafe production mutations only with explicit user approval.

checks.requirement: Refund request or real refund path is validated with merchant/backend status update, or explicitly waived when no safe payment/refund data exists.
checks.nextAction: Requires explicit user approval before real refund. Record non-secret result or waiver.

checks.requirement: Expired token, network/API failure, payment cancel/failure, invalid form data, and denied phone authorization show understandable feedback and recovery path.
checks.nextAction: Record sanitized examples from preview/real-device QA.
